This is my maize plot here in Ruvuma, and even though it's only a small piece, maize is what feeds my family so I must treat it well. I've been farming many years and I've seen that without a little fertilizer the yields are poor, so I will buy a small amount of CAN or urea to top-dress — maybe half a bag split across this plot and another. I also spread manure from the household when I can, and I try to get improved seed from the agrodealer in town because it yields better than keeping my own. I'm 63 now so I cannot do all the work myself — my family helps, and for the heavy weeding I hire a young man for a few days.
